Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: high fidelity game UI concept, ONE complete landscape mobile screen, target 2532 by 1170 (logical viewport 844 by 390).
Primary request: Design the profession selection panel for the EXISTING Chinese fantasy action RPG in the reference. Keep the project's established dark brown-black surfaces, restrained thin warm-gold double outlines, warm ivory Chinese type, dark teal selected text, realistic painted item icons, and the SAME silver-haired male hero in burgundy leather. This is a static design proposal.
Input image 1: visual-language and hero-identity reference ONLY. Build the new layout below; do not reproduce the reference's inventory content.
Composition: straight-on clean screen, no phone hardware, no perspective, no outside presentation board. Full panel within landscape safe margins. Compact header with title 剑与火 at left, six tabs 人物 装备 职业 加点 技能 锻造, 职业 selected, gold count and close X at right. Body is three columns. Left: neutral standing hero and caption 拉斐尔 · Lv11, below 当前职业：破军战技. Middle: FOUR large profession choices in a 2 by 2 grid: 破军战技 (sword motif, badge 当前), 逐风弓术 (bow motif, highlighted with fine gold outline and badge 预览), 烈焰秘术 (flame staff motif), 雷霆秘术 (lightning staff motif). Keep each choice simple, no full character art, one icon and name plus brief role. Right: heading 逐风弓术 and small 预览 badge, text 远程贯穿 · 灵活走位, 主武器：弓, 成长属性：敏捷、体质, then four distinct bow skill icons in one row, one short note 浏览职业不会立即切换. Footer: small status 安全检查点 · 可切换职业 on the left, dark secondary button 取消预览, gold primary button 切换为逐风, and dark button 返回旅途 on the right.
Color palette: #100D0A deep background, #211B16 panel, #DAAE65 warm gold edges, #F7DA9D heading, #EDE4CB body, #75C5B9 selected teal. Do not use large yellow panels. Text must be crisply legible Simplified Chinese. Buttons and profession choices are substantial for finger touch, around 48 logical px high minimum, with visible 8px spacing. Main body height about 244 logical px; avoid overcrowding.
Constraints: Preserve reference hero appearance and material language. No web dashboard design, no chart, no neon UI, no sci-fi, no invented classes, no ice class, no new title or slogan, no English filler. Selection is clearly a PREVIEW, current profession remains 破军战技 until explicit confirmation. Keep gold trim subtle and clean.
